literal: Association (and) interacting are not needed; mutual feeling indeed friendship becoming right will give.
translation: Constant association and close interaction are not necessary. Mutual understanding alone grants the intimate rights of friendship.
modern: உடலால் ஒன்றாகச் சேர்ந்து பழகுதல் நட்புக்குத் தேவையில்லை; இருவருக்கும் இடையிலான ஒத்த உணர்வே நட்புக்கு உரிய உரிமையைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet redefines the basis of true friendship by separating it from physical proximity. It states that constantly meeting ('புணர்ச்சி') and spending time together ('பழகுதல்') are not required to form a bond. Instead, it is the alignment of minds and mutual empathy ('உணர்ச்சி') that truly grants the rights and intimacy ('கிழமை') of friendship. The emphasis is entirely on emotional and intellectual connection over mere physical presence.
